notes.title: [Update ver1.6] Russian, Polish, Simplified Chinese Full Localization !!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year!
I will continue to do my best to update our website for a while to satisfy all of you this year. Thank you for your continued support.

With this update, some languages are now almost fully localized.
Fully supported: [Russian, Polish, Simplified Chinese]

I would like to express my sincere thanks to all those who have helped with the translation. Many other people have also been working on translations, and localization of other languages is in progress.

For more information about the translation work, please refer to here. Any help at all would be greatly appreciated. I would be happy if even more people would edit it.

Changes
UI

The cursor indicating the current position on the map now glows, making it easier to see.
Fixed a bug with the map image and text for stairs, so that down stairs and up stairs can now be clearly distinguished.
Translator credits have been updated to the latest version.


System

Checkpoints have been added so that you can resume from a specific location when you die.
Changed some of the handling of the achievement of finding 40 secrets to fix a bug that caused it to be achieved prematurely. However, it may not have been completely fixed.


Localization

Fully supported: Russian, Polish, Simplified Chinese
Other languages also reflect the latest translations by volunteers.


Graphics

Fixed a bug where the cloak would move violently when a dead enemy came into view.

notes.title: Ver1.0 update
notes.notes:
Fixed a problem with the black pressure plate
This bug did not occur in my environment and I cannot confirm the phenomenon, so I do not know if this fixes it. Sorry if it is not fixed.

Maybe this update itself may cause problems.
For example, if Steam's automatic patching system does not adapt and all game files are re-downloaded, I would appreciate it if you could report it to me.

In some cases, the images that appear in the save slots may have disappeared because the Steam cloud settings have been changed. In that case, I am sorry, but you cannot display the images except by saving again in the game.

notes.title: Release Date: December 7th!
notes.notes:
We deeply appreciate your patience. 
Thanks to your support, we are thrilled to announce the official release of the full version. 
We extend our heartfelt gratitude and apologies to those who have been eagerly waiting.

A new horror-filled RPG survival experience is coming soon! 
This game captures the charm of 1980s dungeon RPGs while offering a completely new experience. 
Step into the mysterious deep tower where bizarre masked humans roam!

notes.title: Demo version major update v.1.1.0
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for your participation in Steam Next Fest and many feedbacks.
We have updated the system of the demo version based on the feedback.

Changes
Added effects such as slashing and bleeding. Addition of sound effects.
Notation of enemy HP and damage.
Left click is now the only way to attack.
Holding a weapon with the right mouse button will now build up the attack and increase its power.
You can now touch objects only with the left click without opening the inventory.
Some changes to the map.
